data.description:
## Operator directive (2026-08-13, verbatim)
'you're authorized to configure our bridge to run hourly instead of continuously for this project in order to free the runner.'

## Already done (config, immediate)
RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS repo Variable flipped true -> false at 2026-08-13T14:59Z. The self-re-dispatch chain stops after its in-flight pass; the runner slot frees. The bridge now runs solely on reconcile-bridge.yml's cron.

## Remaining (code change, post-pause)
The cron is the 40-minute three-entry schedule change 1726 just landed. Operator intent is HOURLY for this project: replace the three-entry 40-min block with a single hourly entry (off-:00 minute per scheduling hygiene, e.g. '23 * * * *'), update the gap-asserting cadence test 1726 added (and any pinned literals/docs/Jenkinsfile mirror), and update the canary staleness-window arithmetic if it keys off the bridge cadence (canary itself stays 2-hourly per pittabird). Update the workflow comments naming 40-min.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] reconcile-bridge.yml fires hourly (single cron entry, off-:00 minute); no other trigger fires the bridge for this repo (chain variable false is config, not asserted by CI).
- [ ] The cadence test derives and asserts the hourly schedule; all pinned literals/docs/comments/Jenkinsfile updated truthfully.
- [ ] Worst-case sync latency (1h) recorded in the bridge docs.
data.title: Bridge schedule to hourly now that continuous is off
